{{TOCright}}
==Syntax==
<pre>{{Quote
 | quote                    = 
 | speakers                 = 
 | addressees               = 
 | pseudosource             = 
 | description              = 
 | description_extra        = 
 | topic                    = 
 | early_refs               = 
 | other_refs               = 
 | quote_border             = 
 | quote_marks              = 
 | quote_margins            = 
 | quote_width              = 
 | quote_render_refs        = 
 | quote_render_description = 
}}</pre>


==Usage==

===Basic===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|Quotation}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|Quotation}}

===Missing quote===

 <nowiki>{{Quote}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote}}

----

===Attribution===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|Quotation|Mat}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|Quotation|Mat}}

----

===Basic with topic===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|quote=Quotation|description=Source|topic=Topic}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|quote=Quotation|description=Source|topic=Topic}}

===Missing description===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|quote=Quotation|speakers=Mat|topic=Topic}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|quote=Quotation|speakers=Mat|topic=Topic}}

===Reference===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|quote=Quotation|other_refs={{ref|A reference}}}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|Quotation|||{{ref|A reference}}}}

===Early reference===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|quote=Quotation|early_refs={{ref|A reference}}}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|quote=Quotation|early_refs={{ref|A reference}}}}

===Full===

<pre>{{Quote
 | quote = Quotation
 | description = Somebody
 | topic = Topic
 | early_refs = {{ref|Early reference}}
 | other_refs = {{ref|A reference}}
}}</pre>
produces:

{{Quote
 | quote = Quotation
 | description = Somebody
 | topic = Topic
 | early_refs = {{ref|Early reference}}
 | other_refs = {{ref|A reference}}
}}

----

===Internal quote marks===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|Lews Therin Telamon wandered the palace, deftly keeping his balance when the earth heaved. "Ilyena! My love, where are you?"|Lews Therin Telamon}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|Lews Therin Telamon wandered the palace, deftly keeping his balance when the earth heaved. "Ilyena! My love, where are you?"|Lews Therin Telamon}}

----

===Internal italics and quote marks, with attribution link and footnote===

 <nowiki>{{Quote|''Dovie’andi se tovya sagain.'' "It’s time to toss the dice."|[[Mat Cauthon]] (inner monologue){{ref/book|6|5}}}}</nowiki>
produces:

{{Quote|''Dovie’andi se tovya sagain.'' "It’s time to toss the dice."|[[Mat Cauthon]] (inner monologue){{ref/book|6|5}}}}

----

===Quote with surrounding text===

<pre>Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation|Mat}}
Some later text

Some even later text</pre>
produces:

Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation|Mat}}
Some later text

Some even later text

----

===Immediately consecutive quotes with surrounding text===

<pre>Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1|Alice}}
{{Quote|Quotation 2|Bob}}

Some later text

Some even later text</pre>
produces:

Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1|Alice}}
{{Quote|Quotation 2|Bob}}

Some later text

Some even later text

----

===Spaced consecutive quotes with surrounding text===

<pre>Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 2|Bob}}

Some later text

Some even later text</pre>
produces:

Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 2|Bob}}

Some later text

Some even later text

----

===Consecutive quotes with breaks===

<pre>Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 2 line 1
Quotation 2 line 2|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 3 line 1<br />Quotation 3 line 2|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 4 line 1<br />
Quotation 4 line 2|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 5|Bob}}

Some later text

Some even later text</pre>
produces:

Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 2 line 1
Quotation 2 line 2|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 3 line 1<br />Quotation 3 line 2|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 4 line 1<br />
Quotation 4 line 2|Alice}}

{{Quote|Quotation 5|Bob}}

Some later text

Some even later text

===Consecutive quotes without attribution===

<pre>Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1}}
{{Quote|Quotation 2}}

Some later text

Some even later text</pre>
produces:

Some earlier text

{{Quote|Quotation 1}}
{{Quote|Quotation 2}}

Some later text

Some even later text
